_comment: The pilots MDS_NON_SOLAR may act on (same family as MDS_AUTOMATION). mds_target.bootstrap() refuses any profile whose pilot is not listed here, before the target is applied and before any network call. Never add 88001.
forbidden_note: 88001 (masterpilot01, bidgely-masterpilot-resi-fl-productqa) is deliberately excluded: it has no NVE lineage and its own separate automation. Never add it here.
